transcript.text: I was in Shanghai back in 2025 and it felt like every other conversation was about where to eat and who to call for repairs at home.

transcript.text: My neighbor even sent me a screenshot of their home visit details—date was 2025-03-25 and they picked the morning slot, but it was all already handled.

transcript.text: They said the tech showed up to Room 106, Building B, South Apartment, and the contact phone on the order was 13845678901—nothing for me to do, just gossip.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: They went at 19:00 and it was just party size 2—honestly sounded cozy, but it’s long done now.
